name: toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A set of toggle buttons behaving as either radio group or checkbox group. Use it for view switches and filter bars where all options should stay visible.
docs: Named exports: ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem, getThemeStyles. Set `type` to single or multiple — `value` is a string for single, an array for multiple. Compose ToggleGroupItem children; the group passes theme and size down.
